offers_products.reason: Main offering is leased warehouse space; forklifts, racking and solar are minor add-ons to leasing.

offers_services.reason: REIT leasing logistics facilities to customers, plus development, energy and turnkey warehouse services; REITs count as services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Tenants are retailers, 3PLs, manufacturers and e-commerce businesses leasing warehouses, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Leases warehouses to businesses such as retailers, 3PLs, manufacturers and meal kit providers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Rental income from multi-year warehouse leases to tenants.

cyclical_demand.reason: Tenants are bound by multi-year leases and need logistics space; demand for space is fairly steady.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay recurring rent rather than making large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for property and facilities, not mainly for staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main tenants are large global retailers, 3PLs, manufacturers and e-commerce companies operating at scale.

asset_heavy.reason: REIT owning and developing billions of square feet of warehouses, which requires heavy ongoing property investment.

notes: Prologis is a REIT. Warehouse leasing is the main business. Essentials, energy and ventures are smaller add-ons.
